title: NIST WebBook: Magnesium is Mg, molecular weight 24.3050 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Magnesium as Mg, molecular weight 24.3050 amu, CAS 7439-95-4.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Magnesium, CAS Registry Number 7439-95-4, lists molecular formula Mg and molecular weight 24.3050 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 23.985041700 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Mg. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
